title: 5 Tools You Need Before Building With Claude Code
description:
Most people use Claude Code alone and wonder why their sites look basic. These 5 tools fix that completely. Impeccable handles design quality. Playwright automates your testing. Supabase sets up your database and auth. GitHub keeps your code versioned. Vercel ships everything live. All from your terminal, nothing else needed.
Get the full install guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qD9DO3NZ7OP3_QjQd8DmmNlg4acu1XOYsH9Sz34XbA4/edit?usp=sharing
#claudecode #webdev #aitools #coding #vercel
